about: Klutz does not stop Bestow: the ability keeps an item from working, not from changing hands (Bulbapedia's Klutz; Showdown's bestow). In the Violet Gym the player's Snorlax, given Klutz, holds Leftovers and knows Bestow alone; Falkner's Hoothoot holds nothing (set:, teach:). The Leftovers go to the Hoothoot, where the engine's subscript said Klutz made the move ineffective.
